intent.outcome: andre's direct Cargo graph is minimal: unused deps gone, deprecated YAML replaced or justified, small helpers (dirs/thiserror/anyhow/unicode-width/optional clap) replaced with std or local modules where cheaper than a crate, and every remaining direct dependency has a one-line reason. make ci stays green.

problem.description: The workspace is small but un-audited: dead dev-deps, deprecated serde_yaml, and several crates used only as thin wrappers (dirs, thiserror, anyhow, unicode-width direct, clap for a handful of flags) that we can own ourselves. M06 cleans the graph before M07 native engine grows the core.

in_scope: Audit all direct deps in workspace/andre/andre-core Cargo.toml (prod + dev).
DIY-1: Remove unused crates/features and dead dev-deps (assert_cmd, andre-core crossterm, predicates if unused); trim tokio features if safe.
DIY-2: Replace dirs with a small local home/config path helper.
DIY-3: Replace thiserror with hand-written Display/Error on andre_core::Error.
DIY-4: Remove anyhow; binary uses andre_core::Error or a thin local Result alias (no anyhow type in signatures).
DIY-5: Replace clap with std::env::args for existing flags + -h/--help (preferred). Retain clap only if blocked, with one-line reason in dep table.
unicode-width direct dep: remove via tiny local helper OR keep and document in dep table (either OK).
Migrate serde_yaml to a maintained serde-compatible YAML crate; andre.yml shape unchanged.
Document dependency policy + one-line purpose table for every remaining direct prod dep + DIY notes.
ratatui/crossterm pin bump only in final S6 after M05 complete (this milestone depends_on 05).
make ci green; CHANGELOG note for dep removals / YAML crate / optional ratatui bump.
out_of_scope: DIY full YAML parser (migrate crate only; keep serde).
Rewriting tokio async execute model (feature-trim only).
Adding tracing or other new major deps unless required by YAML migration.
Rewriting config format away from YAML.
Parallel execution with M05 (blocked by depends_on).

design_decisions.choice: Prefer a maintained serde-compatible YAML crate with deny_unknown_fields parity; keep on-disk andre.yml shape unchanged
design_decisions.rationale: User-facing config must not break; only the parser implementation swaps.

design_decisions.choice: M06 includes DIY-1..5: drop unused; replace dirs, thiserror, anyhow; optional clap→std args; optional unicode-width local helper. Not DIY: ratatui, crossterm, full YAML, tokio rewrite, stow binary.
design_decisions.rationale: Low-risk ownership of thin wrappers without rebuilding the TUI or config stack.

design_decisions.choice: Prefer removing clap if flag surface stays small; retain only if --help/completions ergonomics win the tradeoff, documented in the dep table
design_decisions.rationale: DIY-5 is optional by design; either outcome is valid if justified.

design_decisions.choice: Treat M06 as medium effort (M): DIY path/error/CLI plus YAML migrate, not a drive-by prune
design_decisions.rationale: Multiple crate removals touch core error paths and main CLI; needs full ci.

design_decisions.choice: No hard depends_on M05; may run after or parallel. If ratatui bump conflicts, finish M05 pure-render first or bump only in S6.
design_decisions.rationale: Dep DIY does not require pure-render seams; coordinate pin bumps only.

design_decisions.choice: depends_on M05. Run only after M05 complete. Do not start in parallel with M05/M07.
design_decisions.rationale: app.rs/main.rs/error paths shared with M05; config/YAML shared with M07.

findings.description: parse_args replaced clap but reads std::env::args and calls process::exit inline, so it has no unit tests. Only 3 e2e binary tests cover a subset of flag forms. --help, unknown args, --config=VALUE, -cVALUE, missing-value, and --log-file are uncovered (L1: green tests do not imply correct behavior; L2: reproducers catch what suites miss). clap provided this coverage for free. Refactor to a pure parse(argv) -> Result<Args, UsageError> and add unit tests locking each flag form + error path.

paths::config_dir claims to replace dirs::config_dir but on macOS dirs returned ~/Library/Application Support while DIY returns ~/.config (XDG). Docs already advertise XDG, so primary is correct, but macOS users who relied on the old dirs path lose silent discovery. ConfigSearch should also probe ~/Library/Application Support/andre on macOS (back-compat) and CHANGELOG should note the dual path; clarify paths.rs docs that product semantics are XDG-first, not full dirs parity.
findings.author: external-agent

findings.description: CLI equals-attached forms accept empty values: --config=, --log-file=, and -c= (after '=' strip) set PathBuf::from("") instead of Usage error. Space form correctly rejects empty via take_value. L2: empty path later fails confusingly at config load. Reject empty values for all value-taking forms and add unit tests.
findings.author: external-agent

findings.description: fn main() -> Result<()> relies on std Termination which prints errors with Debug ({err:?}), not Display. Hand-written andre_core::Error Debug shows enum variants (e.g. Io(Os {..})) instead of the user-facing Display strings. Pre-anyhow this was softened by anyhow's Debug; now worse. Use try_main + eprintln!("{e}") + exit(1) so users see Display messages.
findings.author: external-agent

findings.description: Workspace/crate Cargo.toml files lost trailing newlines (Cargo.toml, andre/Cargo.toml, andre-core/Cargo.toml). POSIX text files should end with newline; some tools and git diffs are noisier without it. Restore final newlines.
